name: Hobble Bauble
description:
Once per day, you may speak the bauble's command word as a free action. For the next minute, if it comes into contact with any creature other than the one that activated it, it attaches to it, expands to one foot in diameter and becomes 50 times heavier.

It remains attached for one hour, or until a creature passes a Strength roll against Difficulty 18 to remove the bauble. Either way, when the bauble detaches, it returns to its normal size and weight.
